transcript: Ava is joining a bright habitat rescue mission. Three animals need help getting back to the home where they can live safely. A black bear, a sea otter, and a desert tortoise are waiting with a habitat map. Each one needs the right home to stay safe and strong. The bear looks for tall trees and cool shade. The sea otter looks for ocean water and long kelp. The tortoise looks for dry sand and warm sun. Now that the clues are clear, it is time to drag each animal to the habitat where it belongs and earn shining stars.
